title: Concept: Legacy moz-binding property in a style
description: A style block that uses the moz-binding property in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The property loaded XBL bindings that could execute script, and its presence shows that untrusted CSS reaches the page without property filtering.
applicability: Deployments that render a style block that uses the moz-binding property into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The property loaded XBL bindings that could execute script, and its presence shows that untrusted CSS reaches the page without property filtering.
